test_dataframe_repr_returns_string: test that DataFrame.__repr__ returns a string object for DataFrames with unicode indices and columns
test_dataframe_repr_with_nulls: test DataFrame repr handles different null types including NaT, NaN, None, and True as index or column labels
test_dataframe_repr_with_multiindex: test DataFrame repr with MultiIndex containing NaT values and long column names
test_dataframe_repr_display_options: test DataFrame repr respects display options like precision, max_rows, max_columns, and show_dimensions
test_series_repr_complex_nans: test Series and DataFrame repr with complex NaN values in various real and imaginary configurations
